name: golden-hour
description: Local sun times and photography light windows.

interface.longDescription:
Plan photography with golden hour time, sunrise sunset times, blue hour and twilight times for a city and local date. Sunvane Golden Hour calculates morning and evening light windows, solar noon, day length, and sunrise and sunset direction. Use the interactive card to change a city or date.

Plan photography golden hour shoots for 1 to 31 days, then download an ICS calendar with one event per light window and a CSV table. Compare day length between two dates, or use a year for its equinoxes and solstices. Local times use IANA time zones and daylight saving changes. Missing polar events are reported.

Golden hour means sun altitude −4° to +6°; blue hour −6° to −4°. Sunrise/sunset use −0.833°; civil, nautical and astronomical twilight use −6°, −12° and −18°. Windows crossing local midnight are clipped and marked.

Examples: golden hour calculator for New York, NY, on 06/21/2026; evening shoots in Los Angeles, CA, starting 10/12/2026 for 7 days.

Limits: a flat horizon at sea level; hills, buildings and weather change the real light. Accuracy is about one minute below 66° latitude and uncertainty increases near polar transitions. City coverage is population 50,000+ plus Tromso; dates 1900–2100. Day length is daylight within a local civil date. City matches are ranked by population; the first is used and other matches are listed so country or US state can narrow it. Files do not change a calendar. Local clocks follow the host IANA time-zone database; future rules may change.

City data adapted from GeoNames (https://www.geonames.org/), licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
defaultPrompt: What time is golden hour in New York, NY, on 06/21/2026?
Plan 7 evening golden hour shoots in Los Angeles, CA, starting 10/12/2026.
Compare day length in Chicago, IL, on 03/20/2026 and 06/21/2026.

positive.prompt: What time is golden hour in New York, NY, on 06/21/2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports New York City, NY, US in America/New_York with sunrise 2026-06-21 05:25:01, sunset 2026-06-21 20:30:46, and day length 15h 5m 45s. Shows golden hour, blue hour and twilight with altitude definitions.

positive.prompt: Plan 7 evening golden hour shoots in Los Angeles, CA, starting 10/12/2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns 7 golden hour calendar events with local windows, ICS and CSV downloads.

positive.prompt: Compare day length in Chicago, IL, on 03/20/2026 and 06/21/2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns daylight difference 11062 seconds and average 118.95 seconds/day.

positive.prompt: Find sunrise sunset times and blue hour in Tromso, Norway, on 12/21/2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports sunrise and sunset do not occur on this date, day length 0h 0m 0s, and available twilight and light windows.

positive.prompt: Compare day length at the equinoxes and solstices of 2026 in New York, NY.
positive.expected_behavior: Computes local seasonal dates and daylight durations, with signed differences and average changes per day.

pl-PL.subtitle: Słońce i planowanie zdjęć
pl-PL.description: Oblicz wschód i zachód słońca, złotą i niebieską godzinę oraz zmierzch dla miasta i daty. Zaplanuj zdjęcia na okres do 31 dni z plikami ICS i CSV. Porównaj długość dnia. Czasy lokalne uwzględniają zmianę czasu. Płaski horyzont na poziomie morza; teren i pogoda wpływają na światło. Miasta od 50 000 mieszkańców, lata 1900–2100. Dane miast: GeoNames, CC BY 4.0.

de-DE.subtitle: Sonnenzeiten & Fotoplanung
de-DE.description: Berechne Sonnenaufgang, Sonnenuntergang, goldene und blaue Stunde sowie Dämmerung für Stadt und Datum. Plane bis zu 31 Tage mit ICS- und CSV-Dateien und vergleiche die Tageslänge. Ortszeiten berücksichtigen die Sommerzeit. Flacher Horizont auf Meereshöhe; Gelände und Wetter beeinflussen das Licht. Städte ab 50.000 Einwohnern, Jahre 1900–2100. Stadtdaten: GeoNames, CC BY 4.0.

es-ES.subtitle: Sol y planificación de fotos
es-ES.description: Calcula la salida y puesta del sol, hora dorada, hora azul y crepúsculo para una ciudad y fecha. Planifica hasta 31 días con archivos ICS y CSV y compara la duración del día. Horas locales con horario de verano. Horizonte plano al nivel del mar; el terreno y clima afectan la luz. Ciudades de al menos 50.000 habitantes, años 1900–2100. Datos: GeoNames, CC BY 4.0.

fr-FR.subtitle: Soleil et séances photo
fr-FR.description: Calculez le lever et coucher du soleil, les heures dorée et bleue et le crépuscule pour une ville et une date. Planifiez jusqu’à 31 jours avec fichiers ICS et CSV et comparez la durée du jour. Heures locales tenant compte du changement d’heure. Horizon plat au niveau de la mer ; relief et météo influencent la lumière. Villes dès 50 000 habitants, années 1900–2100. Données : GeoNames, CC BY 4.0.

ja-JP.subtitle: 太陽の時刻と撮影計画
ja-JP.description: 都市と日付から日の出・日の入り、ゴールデンアワー、ブルーアワー、薄明の時刻を計算します。最大31日間の撮影計画をICSとCSVで出力し、日照時間を比較できます。現地時刻は夏時間を考慮します。海面高度の平らな地平線を想定し、地形や天候は光に影響します。人口5万人以上の都市、1900～2100年に対応。都市データ：GeoNames、CC BY 4.0。

pt-BR.subtitle: Sol e planejamento de fotos
pt-BR.description: Calcule nascer e pôr do sol, hora dourada, hora azul e crepúsculo para uma cidade e data. Planeje até 31 dias com arquivos ICS e CSV e compare a duração do dia. Horários locais consideram o horário de verão. Horizonte plano ao nível do mar; relevo e clima afetam a luz. Cidades com pelo menos 50 mil habitantes, anos 1900–2100. Dados: GeoNames, CC BY 4.0.
